description: This is a header file defining an interface for a simple unnamed semaphore in C. It includes function declarations for creating, destroying, posting to, waiting on, and obtaining the value of a semaphore, tailored for single-process use.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Create
methods.description: Creates an unnamed semaphore initialized to 0.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Post
methods.description: Increments the semaphore value by 1 and wakes any waiting threads.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the semaphore.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Wait
methods.description: Waits indefinitely until the semaphore has a value > 0.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_TimedWait
methods.description: Waits until either the semaphore has a value > 0 or the specified timeout expires.
